{How can Black use the fork trick to reach a good position?} 6... Nxe4 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a good capture.] [%hint Sacrifice a
knight temporarily so that you can win it back with a good position.]} (6...
O-O $5 {This is a good move, but there's an even better one. Try to find a
strong capture.}) (6... e6 $5 {This is a good move, but there's an even better
one. Try to find a strong capture.}) (6... a6 $5 {This is a good move, but
there's an even better one. Try to find a strong capture.}) 7. Nxe4 {Good
move! How can you win back your lost piece?} d5 {[%wrong White is winning. Try
again.] [%hint Fork White's bishop and knight in the center.]} 8. Bd3 {Good
move! Keep it up.} dxe4 {[%wrong White is winning. Try again.] [%hint Capture
a piece.]} 9. Bxe4 {Great job! How can you win material?} Nxd4 {[%wrong
There's a stronger move. Try to find it.] [%hint What can you capture to win
material?] Well played! Black is up a pawn with a good position.} (9... Bxd4 $2
10. Bxc6+ {White wins the bishop on d4. Try again.}) *

{How should White punish Black's early Nd7 mistake?} 5. Bxf7+ {[%wrong There's
a better move. Try again and look for a good attacking option?] [%hint
Sacrifice material to draw the black king into danger.]} (5. Ng5 $5 e6 {
White is doing well after Bxe6 here, but there's a much stronger move. Try to

material with interest?} 6. Ng5+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and

White win the game?} 7. Qf3# {[%wrong There's a checkmate, but that's not it.
Try again and look for a way to win the game.] [%hint Look at your checks.
Which one is mate?] Well done!} *

{What clever move does White often play here to prevent d6-d5 from being a
worrying threat?} 5. Bb3 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look
for a useful retreat.] [%hint Retreat your bishop but stay on the a2-g8
diagonal.] Good choice! Now White can meet d6-d5 with either e5 or Nc3.
Neither of those would be an option if the bishop were still on c4 and subject
to attack.} (5. O-O $5 {This is reasonable, but White most frequently plays a
retreat so that d5 from Black won't be a dangerous threat. What should you
play?}) (5. d5 $2 Nf6 {Black has good counterplay against the white pawn
center. Try again and look for a way to prepare against Black's d6-d5 advance.})
(5. Nc3 $5 {This is reasonable, but White most frequently plays a retreat so
that d5 from Black won't be a dangerous threat. What should you play?}) (5. Bf4
$5 {This is reasonable, but White most frequently plays a retreat so that d5
from Black won't be a dangerous threat. What should you play?}) (5. Bd3 $2 Nc6
{The bishop is better off on the a2-g8 diagonal. Try to find a better square
for it.}) (5. Be2 $2 Nf6 {The bishop is better off on the a2-g8 diagonal. Try
to find a better square for it.}) *

{How did Maxime Vachier-Lagrave (MVL), start a strong attack?} 24. Rd6 {
[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try again and check the hint if you're stuck.]
[%hint Find a strong outpost for your d1-rook so that if Black captures it,
there will be fewer defenders of the f7-pawn.]} (24. Rxd7 $2 Rxd7 {Black
recaptures with a safe position. Try again and look for a stronger rook move.})
(24. Ra1 $2 Rd4 {Black dominates the e-file with a good game. Try again and
look for a better rook move.}) (24. h5 $2 Rxd1 {Black wins a rook. Try again
and look for a strong rook move.}) 24... Rxd6 {Great idea! What's next?} 25.
exd6 {[%wrong There's a much stronger move. Try again and look for a good
capture.] [%hint Recapture and attack the black queen.]} Rxd6 {Nice move! How
did MVL win back the sacrifice material and maintain a strong attack?} 26. Nxf7
{[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a powerful attacking
move.] [%hint Sacrifice a knight to decoy the black queen away from the
d6-rook.] Well played! Black can't safely recapture on f7 without losing the
d6-rook. White had a vicious attack and later won in Vachier Lagrave -Aronian,
2018.} (26. Nh5+ $5 {This is a great move, but MVL preferred a strong capture.
Try to find his idea as well.}) (26. Qe5+ $2 f6 {White can get a good position
with Nxe6+, but there's a stronger attacking move. Try to find it.}) (26. Rd1
$2 Rxd1+ {Black captures the rook with check and then wins the queen. Try
again and look for a better attacking move.}) *

{White's e5-push was premature. How should Black get a great position?} 3...
dxe5 {[%wrong White wins material. Try again and look for a good capture.] 
[%hint Find a good capture.]} (3... Ne4 $2 4. Qe2 {The knight will soon be
trapped. Try again and look for a better option than moving the knight.}) (3...
Nd5 $2 4. c4 {The knight must move again. Try again and look for a better
option than moving the knight.}) (3... Nfd7 $2 4. Nf3 {White has a safe
position. Try again and look for a better option than moving the knight.}) (
3... Ng8 $2 4. Nf3 {White has a safe position. Try again and look for a better
option than moving the knight.}) 4. dxe5 {Nice move! How should you take
advantage of the newly open d-file?} Qxd1+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try
again and look for a way to win material.] [%hint Trade queens and follow up
with a knight fork.]} 5. Kxd1 {Good idea! How should you save your knight?} Ng4
{[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for the best square for
your knight.] [%hint Save your knight and fork two white pawns.] Good work!
White can defend the f2-pawn, but Black will soon capture on e5 with an extra
pawn and a great position.} (5... Ne4 $2 6. Be3 {There's a much stronger
knight move. Try again and look for a useful fork.}) (5... Nd5 $2 6. Nf3 {
There's a much stronger knight move. Try again and look for a useful fork.}) (
5... Nfd7 $2 6. e6 {There's a much stronger knight move. Try again and look
for a useful fork.}) (5... Ng8 $2 6. Bb5+ {There's a much stronger knight move.
Try again and look for a useful fork.}) (5... Nh5 $2 6. Nc3 {There's a much
stronger knight move. Try again and look for a useful fork.}) *

] [%hint Advance a pawn to avoid a trade on d4.] Well played! Black will have

{White has just captured on c5, but Black doesn't need to recapture right away.
How should you fight for the initiative?} 7... Qa5 {[%wrong There's a better
move. Try again and look for a way to develop and make a pin.] [%hint Develop
and pin the c3-knight.]} (7... dxc5 $2 8. O-O {White has better center control
and an advantage. Try again and look for a useful developing move.}) (7... Nc6
$2 8. O-O {White gives back the pawn with a good position. Try again and look
for a good capture.}) 8. cxd6 {Great start! White would have been better off
castling and simply giving back the pawn on c5. Now Black can develop a quick
attack. What should you play?} Nxe4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again
and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture a pawn and attack the pinned
knight.]} (8... exd6 $2 9. Nd2 {White unpins c3 and defends e4, with a good
position. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) 9. dxe7 {Nice move! How
should you save your rook?} Re8 {[%wrong There's a stronger option. Try again
and look for a way to save your rook.] [%hint Find a safe square for your rook.
] Good work! Black has the much safer king and will soon win back material on
c3 or e7.} (9... Bxc3+ $2 10. bxc3 {Black's OK, but will likely regret giving
up the powerful g7-bishop. Try again and look for a way to save your rook.}) (
9... Nxc3 $2 10. exf8=Q+ {White wins the rook with check. Try again and look
for a way to save your rook.}) *

{Black should have played Nb6 instead of dxe5. How can White launch a strong
sacrificial attack?} 8. Bxf7+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a
strong sacrifice.] [%hint Sacrifice to draw out the black king.]} (8. dxe5 $2
Ndxe5 {Black is better. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) (8. Ng5 $2
O-O {Black is better. Try again and look for a faster way to take advantage of
the f7 weakness.}) 8... Kxf7 {Good start! How can you keep up the attack?} 9.
Ng5+ {[%wrong Black is winning. Try again.] [%hint Find a good check.]} (9.
Qc4+ $2 Kf8 {Black can meet Ng5 with Qe8 and keep a good position. Try again.})
9... Ke8 {Great job! How should White keep up the attack?} 10. Qc4 {[%wrong

f7.]} (10. Ne6 $2 Nxd4 {Black is winning after a trade of knights or queens.
Try to find a strong queen move.}) (10. Qf3 $2 Rf8 {Black is winning. Try to
find a stronger queen move.}) 10... e6 {Well played! How should White win back
material?} 11. Nxe6 {[%wrong Black is winning. Try to find a more precise
capture.] [%hint Capture material with a fork.] Well played! White wins back
material with a strong attack.} (11. Qxe6+ $2 Qe7 {Black is slightly better.
Try again.}) *

move.] [%hint Aim to trade your knight for a bishop.]} (7... Na5 $2 8. b4 {
The knight is trapped and White is doing well. Try again and look for a
stronger knight move.}) (7... Nb8 $2 8. Be3 {This is playable, but there's a
better square for the knight. Try to find it.}) 8. Be2 {Good start! How should

one of White's center pawns. How should you do it?}) (8... e6 $2 9. dxe6 {

How should you do it?}) *

{How did GM Ivan Saric contest the strong-looking white pawn center?} 10... f6
{[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a strong pawn break.]
[%hint Aim to trade off the e5-pawn.]} (10... e6 $2 11. Qd2 {Black's dark
squares are vulnerable and White is doing well. Try again and look for a
better move to attack the white center.}) (10... Bxf3 $2 11. Bxf3 {White has
the bishop pair, center control and a threat against h5. Try again and look
for a way to contest the white pawn center.}) 11. exf6 {Good start! How should
you recapture?} exf6 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a
strong capture.] [%hint Recapture and make sure that you don't have an
isolated pawn.] Good work! Black has good counterplay in this sharp position.
He later won in Shirov - Saric, 2018.} (11... Nxf6 $5 {This is playable, but
GM Saric found a stronger capture. What was his idea?}) (11... Bxf6 $2 12. Qd3
{The e-pawn is weak and Black's king is somewhat exposed. Try again and look
for a better capture.}) (11... Rxf6 $2 12. Ng5 {The rook may be vulnerable on
the sixth rank. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) *
